maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from new sales of XBee modules, ConnectCore, routers, Opengear console servers and IoT platforms, not repair or aftermarket.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private enterprises, industrial firms, data centers and product makers buying IoT connectivity hardware, software and subscriptions; government is minor.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through own products and sales; Opengear, Particle, SmartSense were acquired, but as occasional deals rather than a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: XBee and ConnectCore modules are designed into customers' products; Opengear and routers support critical infrastructure, making switching costly.

notes: Digi has made several acquisitions in recent years, so the serial-acquirer answer is a judgment call.
